name: ANUSA Assistance Grant
summary: Non-repayable ANUSA grant for ANU students facing genuine, unexpected financial need.
key: The maximum grant available is $750 per semester.
who: Able to demonstrate genuine and unexpected financial need
Student visa holders must show a genuine and unforeseen change in circumstances after starting their program
how: Complete the online form and select the ANUSA Assistance Grant
Provide a confirmation of enrolment and 60 days of statements from all bank accounts
catches: Applications are assessed individually and may not get the full amount
Does not cover HECS, course fees, debts or vehicle costs

evidence.quote: The maximum grant available is $750 per semester.
Be able to demonstrate genuine and unexpected financial need
